assignee.description: The resource that will use the reservation (for example: projects/myproject, folders/123, organizations/456).
assignee.rationale: This only defines what resource is linked to the reservation. It does not change permissions or access control by itself.

job_type.description: The type of job that is allowed to use this reservation.
job_type.rationale: Job type must be restricted to approved values so the reservation is only used for allowed workloads.

reservation.description: The reservation that the assignee will be linked to.
reservation.rationale: This is just the link to the reservation name and does not change security settings like IAM or encryption.

location.description: The location/region for the reservation assignment.
location.rationale: Location must be set to an approved region to meet compliance and data residency requirements.

project.description: If not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: This only tells Terraform what project to use and does not automatically affect security settings on its own.
